edition: The Apostolic Church, indexed against Redemption Hymnal RH2006
description: 800 canonical number slots for source matching. Only explicitly filled lyrics in the separately bundled hymn data are playable. Unverified titles are null, not fabricated.
copyright_note: A hymn can be traditional while particular text translations or arrangements remain copyrighted. Only add full verse text after source and rights validation.

entries.title_en: Lord of all being, throned afar
All hail the power of Jesu's name!
Praise Him, praise Him, Jesus our blessed Redeemer
entries.title_yo: Fí ìyìn fún Jésù Olùràpadà wa

entries.title_en: We worship and adore Thee
Praise, my soul, the King of heaven
The God of Abraham praise
With harps and with vials there stand a great throng
entries.title_yo: Pẹ̀lú dùùrù wúrà, gbogbo wọn dúró

entries.title_en: Oh, for a thousand tongues to sing
Ye servants of God
entries.title_yo: Ránṣẹ́ Ọlọ́run, ẹ lọ kéde Rẹ

entries.title_en: O worship the King
O God, of good the unfathomed sea!
O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness!
entries.title_yo: Ẹ sin Olúwa nínú ẹwà ìwà mímọ́

entries.title_en: Come, let us join our cheerful songs
Hark! the song of jubilee
O the deep, deep love of Jesus
With gladness we worship, rejoice as we sing
entries.title_yo: Tàyọ̀tàyọ̀ làwa ó máa júbà Rẹ

entries.title_en: Salvation! O the joyful sound!
Thou, great Redeemer, dying Lamb
Praise ye the Lord! 'Tis good to raise
Now in a song of grateful praise
Begin, my soul, some heavenly theme
When morning gilds the skies
My heart and voice I raise
Come, sound His praise abroad
Lord, enthroned in heavenly splendour
Alleluia! sing to Jesus!
God is love; that anthem olden
Praise to the Holiest in the height
Hail, Thou once despised Jesus!
entries.title_yo: A kí Jésù tán kan mọ́ ọ

entries.title_en: Come, my brethren, praise your Saviour
I'll praise my Maker while I've breath
My God, how wonderful Thou art
O Lord of heaven and earth and sea
Sing, O thou happy habitant
O Saviour, precious Saviour
Immortal, invisible, God only wise
Angel voices, ever singing
Praise the Lord! ye heavens, adore Him
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation
Eternal God! we raise to Thee
O Christ, whose glory fills our days
O magnify the Lord with me
Shall hymns of grateful love
Let me sing, for the glory of heaven
Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice
My God, I thank Thee, who hast made
To God be the glory, great things He hath done
My Saviour suffered on the tree
This is the day the Lord hath made
Now thank we all our God
My soul shouts glory to the Son of God
Praise the Saviour, ye who know Him
Praise, praise ye the name of Jehovah, our God
Joy to the world; the Lord is come
Praise the King of glory, He is God alone
Awake, awake, O heart of mine!
O Jesus, King most wonderful
When the morning stars were singing
Father, what can to Thee be given
Eternal Light! Eternal Light!
I need Thee, precious Saviour
Jesus, Thy boundless love to me
Jesus, my eyes are unto Thee
Jesus, stand among us
Fill Thou my life, O Lord my God
Let me come closer to Thee, Lord Jesus
Lord Jesus Christ, we seek Thy face
O for a closer walk with God
O Love Divine, how sweet Thou art!
My goal is God Himself, not joy, nor peace
Love divine, all loves excelling
My God, the spring of all my joys
Here from the world we turn
entries.title_yo: A kọ ayé sílẹ̀, a ń wá Jésù

entries.title_en: Lord of the worlds above
Thou Shepherd of Israel, and mine
Nearer, still nearer, close to Thy heart
It passeth knowledge, that dear love of Thine
If I but knew Thee as Thou art
Talk with us, Lord, Thyself reveal
I cannot breathe enough of Thee
No more veil! God bids me enter
Within the Veil: be this, beloved thy portion
Come ye yourselves apart, and rest awhile
Dear Lord and Father of mankind
Here is love, vast as the ocean
Nothing between, Lord, nothing between
The sands of time are sinking
Speak, Lord, in Thy stillness
Jesus, the very thought of Thee
Jesus, Jesus, Jesus
My heart is resting, O my God
I lift my heart to Thee, Saviour divine
Alone upon the mount of God I stand
Jesus, I am resting, resting
Dwelling in the secret place
Thou the Rose of Sharon
There is a place of quiet rest
Jesus, let Thy splendour
The Lord's my Shepherd, I'll not want
Pleasant are Thy courts above
How lovely is Thy dwelling place
From all that dwell below the skies
The King of love my Shepherd is
O God, our help in ages past
Sweet is the work, my God, my King
All people that on earth do dwell
O thou, my soul bless God the Lord
I to the hills will lift mine eyes
Let us with a gladsome mind
Praise the Lord, His glory show
I waited for the Lord my God
The Lord Jehovah reigns
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty!
Come, Thou almighty King
Thou whose almighty word
O God, Thou bottomless abyss!
God moves in a mysterious way
None is like Jeshurun's God
We plough the fields and scatter
entries.title_yo: A á ròkọ, a á fúnrúgbọn

entries.title_en: When all Thy mercies, O my God
Summer suns are glowing
The spacious firmament on high
Though troubles assail, And dangers affright
I sing th'almighty power of God
Standing at the portal
High in the heav'ns, eternal God
O love of God, how strong and true
Come, ye thankful people, come
For the beauty of the earth
Oh come, all ye faithful
While shepherds watch'd their flocks by night
Christians, awake, salute the happy morn
As with gladness men of old
Brightest and best of the sons of the morning
Hark! The herald angels sing
Thou art the everlasting Word
Oh, how sweet the glorious message
Oh, where is He that trod the sea?
O Thou who art love's primal flame
Come, ev'ry joyful heart
One there is above all others
One day when heaven was filled with His praises
When the Saviour dwelt below
My song is love unknown
Hark! The glad sound the Saviour comes
Jesus my Saviour to Bethlehem came
Thou didst leave Thy throne
Wonderful birth, to a manger He came
I cannot tell why He, whom angels worship
Tell me the story of Jesus
Thou who didst leave Thy Father's Throne
Join all the glorious names
Name of Jesus! Highest Name!
Let earth and heav'n agree
How sweet the Name of Jesus sounds
There is a name I love to hear
Crown Him with many crowns
Take the name of Jesus with you
I've found the 'Pearl of greatest price,'
The name of Jesus is so sweet
When I survey the wonderous cross
O sacred head once wounded
O head once fill'd with bruises
What a wonderful, wonderful Saviour
King of my life, I crown Thee now
Extended on a cursèd tree
'Tis finished! The Messias dies
There is a green hill far away
Not all the blood of beasts
Man of Sorrows! What a name
We sing the praise of Him who died
entries.title_yo: A á kọrin ìyìn ẹni tó kú

entries.title_en: Give me a sight, O Saviour
O Love divine! What hast Thou done?
Beneath the Cross of Jesus
By the Cross of Jesus standing
I stand amaz'd in the presence
Jesus was slain for me
entries.title_yo: A pa Jésù fún mi, ní Kálfárì

entries.title_en: Alas! And did my Saviour bleed?
To Calvery Lord, in spirit now
Jesus lives! No longer now
Thine be the glory, risen, conqu’ring Son
Christ is risen! Hallelujah!
He dies! He dies! The lowly Man of sorrows
Christ the Lord is risen today!
Jesus Christ is risen today
Low in the grave He lay
Look, ye saints! The sight is glorious
Hail the day that sees Him rise
In the Name of Jesus
Jesus shall reign where’er the sun
Majestic sweetness sits enthroned
The head that once was crown’d with thorns
Clap your hands, ye people all
Jesus, when made in the likeness of men
Rejoice! The Lord is King!
The golden gates are lifted up
Golden harps are sounding
See the Conqueror mounts in triumph
God is gone up on high
Arise, my soul, arise
Where high the heavenly temple stands
A good High Priest is come
And didst Thou love the race that loved not Thee?
I know that my Redeemer lives
Spirit of faith, come down
Our blest Redeemer, ere He breath’d
Open my eyes, that I may see
O breath of God, breathe on us now
Gracious Spirit, dwell with me!
Spirit Divine, attend our pray’rs
Come, Holy Spirit, like a dove descending
O Holy Spirit come
Come, Thou everlasting Spirit
Are you looking for the fulness of the blessing of the Lord
O Lord, ‘with one accord,’
Now I feel the sacred fire
I’m rejoicing night and day
Hallelujah sing exulting
The pow’r that fell at Pentecost
‘The Holy Spirit’s power
‘I will not leave you comfortless,’
Holy Ghost, we bid Thee welcome
Come to me, O blessed Spirit
Breathe upon us, Lord, from heaven
O gladsome day of praise
Joys are flowing like a river
Oh, spread the tidings round
The Holy Ghost to me is giv’n
Do you seek a land where there comes no night
Ho, ev’ry one that is thirsty in spirit
Lord God, the Holy Ghost
Of gifts and pow’rs miraculous
Lord, Thy ransom’d Church is waking
Come, Holy Spirit, raise our songs
Tarry for the Spirit
O Spirit of the living God
When first the risen Lord of pow’r
Lord, in Thy presence we are met
God sent His mighty power
Thy sons and daughters, Lord, behold
O men of God, arise!
Lord Jesus, Thou Thy Church hast grac’d
In Thy name, O blessed Saviour
Lord, as of old at Pentecost
‘There shall be showers of blessing’
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
There’s a sound upon the waters
For a world-wide revival, Blessed Master we pray
They were gathered in an upper chamber
There’ll be showers of blessing from our Father’s hand
Blow, pentecostal breeze
Thou Christ of burning, cleansing flame
Floods of revival, Lord, let them fall
O breath of life, come sweeping through us
God is here, and that to bless us
‘With one accord’ within an upper room
Search me, O God, and know my heart today
There’s a shout in the camp ‘Keep the fires burning
Here in Thy name we are gathered
Break Thou the Bread of Life
Standing on the promises of Christ our King
Lord, Thy word abideth
Thy Word is like a garden
How firm a foundation, ye saints of the Lord
Thy Word, O Lord, Thy precious Word alone
Inspirer of the ancient seers,
The Spirit breathe upon the Word
O Word of God incarnate
Come, O Thou Prophet of the Lord
Hungry, Lord for Thy word of truth
Thy words unto my taste are sweet
Oh, Wonderful, wonderful Word of the Lord
Father of mercies, in Thy word
‘Whosoever heareth!’ shout, shout the sound!
All ye that pass by,
Wonderful story of love
Hark! The gospel news is sounding
The cross it standeth fast: Hallelujah, hallelujah!
Sinners Jesus will receive!
Come unto Me, ye weary
Come, let us sing of a wonderful love
Look to Jesus, and be saved
Come, ye sinners, lost and hopeless
Jesus only is our Message
Come, sinners, to the gospel feast
There is a cleansing fountain
I love to tell the story
Would you be free from your burden of sin?
O what a Saviour that He died for me!
There is joy in the presence of the angels in heav’n
Come thou with us, O soul oppressed, and we will do thee good
There is no love like the love of Jesus
Come for the feast is spread
Tell me the old, old, story
Souls of men! Why will ye scatter
’Tis the grandest theme through the ages rung
’Twas Jesus, my Saviour who died on the tree
Come, ye sinners, poor and needy
I’ve a message from the Lord, Hallelujah!
Weary souls, that wander wide
Beautiful words of Jesus
The gospel bells are ringing
Ye who the love of a mother have known
Sound the gospel of grace abroad
Under the burdens of guilt and care
There is life for a look at the Crucified One
Free from the law, oh, happy condition
Come to the Saviour, make no delay
Have you been to Jesus for the cleansing pow’r?
‘Almost persuaded’ now to believe
I hear Thy welcome voice
Jesus, lover of my soul
Today Thy mercy calls me
Pass me not, O gentle Saviour
Ring the bells of Heaven!
How can a weary heart find rest
Where will you spend eternity?
Lord, I hear of show’rs of blessing
Depth of mercy! Can there be
When God of old the way of life
O Jesus, Thou art standing
Will your anchor hold in the storms of life?
O what a wonderful Saviour
And can it be, that I should gain
Grace! ’tis a charming sound
Jesus, the name high over all
O sweet is the story of Jesus
The great Physician now is near
In the misty days of yore
In evil long I took delight
A ruler once came to Jesus by night
Years I spent in vanity and pride
What can wash away my stain?
God loved the world of sinners lost
There is a fountain fill’d with blood
Blessed be the Fountain of blood
Would Jesus have the sinner die?
Grace of God the Father
Oh, this uttermost salvation!
I am happy today and the sun shines bright
Rock of ages, cleft for me
entries.title_yo: Apáta ayérayé, ṣe ibi ìsádi mi

entries.title_en: Oh, now I see the cleansing wave!
There is a story sweet to hear
Great God of wonders! All Thy ways
Who’ll be the next to follow Jesus?
Jesus is tenderly calling thee home
Oh, what will you do with Jesus?
Art thou weary, art thou languid?
entries.title_yo: Àárẹ̀ mú ọ, ayé sú ọ

entries.title_en: I have a Saviour, He’s pleading in glory
Will you take Jesus to be your Guide?
If you from sin are longing to be free
Precious, precious blood of Jesus
Redemption, oh, wonderful story
Just as I am, without one plea
Earthly Pleasures Vainly Call Me
entries.title_yo: Adùn ayé kò jẹ́ nǹkan mọ́

entries.title_en: We Shall See the Desert as the Rose
entries.title_yo: A á rí adùn nínú ìkorò

entries.title_en: The Mercy of God Is an Ocean Divine
entries.title_yo: Àánú Olúwa bí omi òkun ńlá
A fi Ẹ̀mí Mímọ́ fún mi

entries.title_yo: Aláfíà Ọlọ́run ń bẹ lọ́kàn mi

entries.title_yo: Aláfíà ọ̀run, bí odò ńlá ni

entries.title_en: Peace Like a River Is Flooding My Soul
Peace, Perfect Peace, in This Dark World of Sin?
Prayer Is the Soul's Sincere Desire
To the Work

A ti sàn mi pẹ̀lú Kristi

Thine Arm, O Lord, in Days of Old
entries.title_yo: Apá Rẹ ni ojú wọ́n náà
